title: PlanRequest
description: What the scientist asks for in step 1 (MISSION-PLANNER.md). One request drives all six steps and lives in the URL, so a plan is a shareable link: ?body=mars&obj=OP-5LM&type=robotic&months=6-8&days=14&team=6&lim=access:240,protected:0&must=terrain,surfaceMaterial&sort=terrain&top=20&pins=<h3>,<h3>. Every field below maps to one URL key (named in its description). Nothing here is a weight: must/nice and one sort trait only (ADR-0005, AGENTS.md rule 4).

objectiveId.description: URL key: obj. Must name a data/objectives/ row for this body.

category.description: URL key: cat. Test category id from the team doc (it has grown from 8 to 19), kept free here so the list can change without a contract change.

presetCampaignId.description: URL key: preset. A data/campaigns/ row whose published constraints filled the form.

missionType.description: URL key: type. Picks which requirement presets show.

months.description: URL key: months, as start-end (e.g. 6-8). Inclusive; wraps over the new year when start > end (11-2 = Nov, Dec, Jan, Feb).

limits.description: URL key: lim, as key:value pairs. Hard limits: a site outside any of them is filtered out. A site whose value is unknown is NOT filtered by that limit; it is flagged unknown.

access.description: max travel time to the nearest city [minutes], L2 access_min_median

protected.description: max share of protected land [%], L2 protected_pct

airport.description: max distance to the nearest paved-runway airport [km], L2 airport_km

must.description: URL key: must. Traits forced to must (filter). Overrides the trait map's priority.

nice.description: URL key: nice. Traits forced to nice (shown, never filters). Must not overlap `must`.

bandEdits.description: URL key: band, as dimension:lo..hi (append '<' for hiStrict). The user's own bands; each sets origin to 'user' in the site plan.

sortBy.description: URL key: sort. The ONE trait that orders sites inside a Pareto layer (gap on that trait, smallest first).

top.description: URL key: top. Show the first N sites in Pareto-layer order; null or absent = all.

pins.description: URL key: pins. Up to 3 hexagons to compare. The app replaces the oldest on a 4th pin; the contract never holds 4.

successCriteria.description: Per requirement, one line on what 'tested' means. Not in the URL (too long); kept in the URL hash with the checklist.

h3r4.description: H3 resolution-4 cell id (15 hex chars, resolution nibble 4).
